svg.title: 81 lab folders in five clusters; 5 hold no scored result yet
svg.desc: Each column is one cluster of bench folders. The shared planted-chain testbed is connected to the 6 benches whose code reads its corpus. Folders highlighted in blue have a status of foundation, scaffold, spec or frozen design, so they hold no scored result to cite.
svg.text: 81 lab folders, five clusters: the 5 in blue hold no scored result yet
Lines join the shared planted-chain testbed to the 6 benches built on its corpus.
